comparability: Foundry Local serves Microsoft-published ONNX builds through WebGPU/Metal. These are different served artifacts from the digest-pinned vLLM CUDA profiles in config/models.json; results from this registry are mac-plane evidence and are never comparable rows in the frozen Colab campaign.

qwen2.5-0.5b-foundry.description: Plumbing smoke control; assumed too small to hold the agent operating contract.

qwen3-4b-foundry.description: Primary mac agent candidate; same family and scale as the frozen registry's qwen-smoke control (Qwen3-4B).

qwen3-8b-foundry.description: Larger mac agent candidate if 4B quality is insufficient and decode speed allows.

olmo-3-7b-foundry.description: OLMo 3 7B Instruct from the Foundry catalog; closest available to the frozen registry's OLMo family (catalog has no OLMo 3.1).

muse-glimmer-30b-foundry.description: Karl's Muse Glimmer 30B INT4 ONNX conversion (visible-channel 8k profile) served from the mac_bundle custom cache; slow but the only 30B-class candidate.

gemma-4-12b-mlx.description: Gemma 4 12B IT (OptiQ 4-bit) via mlx_lm.server. BLOCKED 2026-08-22: every available 12B conversion declares model_type gemma4_unified, which mlx-lm 0.31.3 does not support yet; retest on mlx-lm updates.

gemma-4-e4b-mlx.description: Gemma 4 E4B IT (OptiQ 4-bit) via mlx_lm.server; the small efficient Gemma 4 variant.

gemma-4-26b-a4b-mlx.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT (OptiQ 4-bit) via mlx_lm.server; 128-expert MoE with ~4B active parameters per token.

olmo-3.1-32b-mlx.description: OLMo 3.1 32B Instruct (lmstudio-community MLX 4-bit) via mlx_lm.server; the same base model family as the frozen campaign target olmo-3.1-32b-instruct, though a different served artifact (quant + runtime), so still mac-plane evidence only.

muse-glimmer-30b-mlx.description: Muse Glimmer 30B via mlx-vlm server (mlx-community 4-bit) with the official DFlash block-diffusion drafter for speculative decoding; the platform-native serving of the same base model as the Foundry ONNX bundle. Requires mlx-vlm (image-text model type), not mlx-lm.

qwen3-embedding-0.6b-foundry.note: Same base model as the frozen qwen3-embedding-0.6b profile, but an ONNX build; vectors are not interchangeable with vLLM campaign vectors.
